lesson_quiz.question: Nguyen nhan chinh nao khien doanh nghiep gia tang chi phi van hanh khi du lieu dang ky bi sai dinh dang?
options: Chi phi luu tru va van chuyen du lieu bang bang dia tang gap doi.
Gia tang ti le loi va that bai khi gui cac thong bao OTP qua SMS hoac Email he thong.
Yeu cau thiet lap lai phan cung may chu moi de chay trinh duyet phia may khach.
Thieu hut lap trinh vien co ky nang xu ly chuoi bang cac bieu thuc toan hoc.
lesson_quiz.explanation: Khi cac thong tin lien lac cot loi nhu so dien thoai va email bi sai dinh dang, viec gui tin nhan xac thuc OTP hoac chien dich tiep thi se that bai, dan den ton chi phi nguon luc thieu hieu qua va sut giam do tin cay.

lesson_quiz.question: Trong bieu thuc chinh quy, ky tu dac biet nao giup xac dinh vi tri dau cua chuoi can kiem tra?
lesson_quiz.explanation: Ky tu ^ la ky tu dai dien vi tri khop voi diem bat dau cua chuoi van ban duoc kiem tra trong Regex.

lesson_quiz.question: Mo hinh nao duoc thu vien re cua Python dung de tang toc do kiem tra phan tich du lieu Regex?
options: Mang luu tru tuyen tinh dong
Cay tim kiem nhi phan can bang
Kien truc phan chia luong lap trinh
lesson_quiz.explanation: Theo thong tin tu bai hoc Stage 1, thu vien re trong Python dung co che bien dich mau Regex thanh cac may trang thai huu han de tang toc do so khop van ban.

lesson_quiz.question: Neu khong su dung Regex va chi dung cac ham kiem tra chuoi co ban, nguoi lap trinh gap bat loi gi?
options: Ma nguon phai viet rat dai dong tuong duong hang tram dong va de bo sot edge case.
Trinh bien dich Python se tu dong tu choi compile file nguon.
He thong database khong the tao moi bang de luu chuoi.
Hieu nang xu ly bo nho RAM cua may chu luon o muc qua tai tren tram phan tram.
lesson_quiz.explanation: Cac dieu kien kiem tra thu cong phuc tap lam phinh to ma nguon len hang tram dong va kho thiet lap duoc tat ca cac dieu kien rang buoc chat che.

practical_lab.title: Khoi Tao Bo Loc Xac Thuc Chuoi Co Ban Voi Regex Python
objectives: Lam quen voi cach nap thu vien re vao tap tin Python.
Viet mau bieu thuc chinh quy co ban su dung ky tu dinh vi dau chuoi.
Kiem tra tinh hop le cua chuoi bang cac ham so khop san co cua Python.

description.inputs: Dự án/môi trường phát triển python/core hiện tại và tài nguyên khóa học.
steps: Buoc 1: Tao mot tap tin python co ten match_validator.py tren he thong cua ban.
Buoc 2: Them dong ma nguon import re vao dau tep tin de su dung thu vien bieu thuc chinh quy.
Buoc 3: Trien khai bieu thuc pattern = r'^admin' de thiet lap dieu kien bat dau voi tu khoa.
Buoc 4: Su dung ham re.match de so sanh kiem tra voi hai chuoi thu nghiem la 'admin123' va 'user_admin' de xem ket qua khac biet.
Buoc 5: Ghi nhan ket qua va in thong bao len console xac nhan bieu thuc dung hay sai.

checklist: Tap tin match_validator.py chay khong xay ra loi cu phap.
Su dung dung tu khoa bat dau cua bieu thuc voi ky tu ^.
In dung ket qua xac thuc cho ca hai truong hop chuoi test dau vao.
